summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the new Onboarding Checklist feature (GET /api/onboarding/status, POST /api/onboarding/state, and OnboardingChecklist.jsx). 8/8 pytest cases passed. All UI flows (checklist visible at top with 3/4 progress for e2e user, product/service CTAs navigate correctly, skip -> compact card, resume -> full checklist, reload persistence, dismiss-compact hides card, all-done -> complete card with go-dashboard button, mobile 390x844 no horizontal scroll) worked as specified. Multi-tenant isolation confirmed (new user sees 0/4 while e2e sees 3/4). Empty state (no company) returns 200 with all steps=false. State restored to skipped=false, dismissed=false after tests.

issues: Pre-existing (not related to onboarding): Recharts warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' fire on initial render. Cosmetic console noise only.

critical_code_review_comments: OnboardingChecklist.jsx correctly uses window focus listener to re-fetch status (matches spec).
Backend uses count_documents({...}, limit=1) — efficient existence check, good.
completed_count aggregates product OR service into a single step (matches spec: total=4).
Onboarding endpoints properly gated by get_current_user (401 without auth verified).
test_credentials: e2e@orcanext.com / NewPass@123 (state restored to skipped=false, dismissed=false at end of tests)
seed_data_creation: Test created a temporary product (TEST_UI_prod) to trigger all-done state, then deleted it. Test also creates ephemeral TEST_onb_* users during pytest run (multi-tenant isolation check) — these remain in DB but are prefixed for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding feature is fully functional. If further tests need to be added, note that the e2e user's state must be reset after any mutation via POST /api/onboarding/state {skipped:false, dismissed:false}. The checklist reads real company_id-scoped data so any test that creates products/services/quotes/clients for e2e user will affect the checklist state.
